summary: 5.198.0–5.205.1 add `fern instructions`, `docs.yml` `remote-paths`, guest docs source upload, locale `search-text`, AI-search `button-text`, and keep OpenAPI `$ref` primitive defaults.
5.196.0–5.197.0 add `fern docs export` (html/md/pdf), print guest SDK build IDs and dashboard links, and quiet the guest end-of-run upgrade check.
5.191.0–5.195.0 fix `fern init --grpc`, point non-interactive runs at `--guest`, send SHA-256 digests for SDK provenance, add `fern docs dev stop`, and improve C/C++ library docs.
5.184.0–5.186.0 add `x-fern-explorer` support in OpenRPC specs, a `config.banner.file` option for the generated CLI's startup banner, and hosted MCP server output in `sdk-config.yml`.
5.180.2–5.183.2 let `fern generate --docs --guest` publish without `--preview`, migrate proto specs in `fern sdk migrate`, pass OpenRPC `paramStructure` to docs and fix large-docs crashes.
5.176–5.180.1 add `fern generate --guest`, `fern claim`, `fern whoami`, `fern docs dev` timeouts and JSON events, and make prompts fail fast when not in a TTY or in CI.
Fern CLI 5.171.2 warns when a docs custom domain still points to Vercel; this becomes an error from 1 Dec 2026.
